battery-reg-2023-1542.detail: For electric-vehicle batteries, light-transport batteries and industrial batteries over 2 kWh.

detergents-2026-405.detail: For the first year, products that meet the old rules may still be placed on the market without one.

toy-safety-2025-2509.detail: For every toy placed on the EU market.

elv-2026-1738.detail: Each new vehicle needs a vehicle passport of its own, which must work with its battery passport.

milestones.title: The EU passport framework comes into force
milestones.detail: The Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation sets up digital product passports. Each product group gets its own rules, and its passport date, through a later Commission act.

milestones.title: Six European passport standards are cited
milestones.detail: Following them gives a presumption that the requirements they cover are met.

milestones.title: Large companies may no longer destroy unsold clothes and shoes
milestones.detail: The ban covers unsold clothing, clothing accessories and footwear. It needs no passport.

milestones.title: The EU registry of passports is due
milestones.detail: The Commission's directory records where each registered passport lives, not what it says. The Commission set it up in July 2026.

milestones.title: The unsold goods rules reach medium-sized companies
milestones.detail: The ban on destroying unsold clothes and shoes, and the yearly report on discarded unsold goods, apply to medium-sized companies too.

plan.source: Ecodesign and Energy Labelling Working Plan 2025 to 2030, COM(2025) 187
